senses.gloss: m. (κρύσταλλος, crystallum) crystal; trnsf. brightness, (with, or sub. פנים; cmp. זִיו) beauty of features, countenance.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 7a:31-32">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>בשכר … זכה לק׳ פנים</he> as a reward for hiding his face (<cite ref="Exodus 3:6">Ex. III, 6</cite>) he was granted the shining face (<cite ref="Exodus 34:29">Ex. XXXIV, 29</cite> sq.).
<cite ref="Niddah 31a">Nidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>והקב״ה נותן … וק׳ פנים וכ׳</he> and God gives it (the embryo) spirit and soul, and beauty of features, and power of sight &c.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 87a:13">B. Mets. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>נהפך ק׳ פנים וכ׳</he> Isaac’s features were changed and made to resemble Abraham’s.
Lev. R. s. 18, beg. (ref. to Koh. XII, 2) השמש זו ק׳ פ׳ ‘the sun (is darkened)’, that means the bright countenance; a. fr.—Pl. (used as sing.) קְלַסְטֵירִין.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 28:1">Ex. R. s. 28</cite>, beg. <he>עשה</he> (<cite ref="B00198"><he>בו</he></cite>) <he>הקב״ה ק׳ של פניו … דומה וכ׳</he> the Lord made Moses’ features resemble those of Abraham.—[<cite ref="Sanhedrin 104b">Snh. 104ᵇ</cite> <he>קלסתר</he> Rashi, v. <cite ref="S01388"><he>קְלַסְתָּא</he></cite>.]
